quest.title: A Small Overture
quest.description: Go to the Frostmoon Enclave, place your tea table, and have Sandrone take a seat. Then, prepare to enjoy some tea with Lauma...

talks.objective: Go to the Frostmoon Enclave to start the tea party

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: ...So, how have the Frostmoon Scions been faring lately?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Quite well. The return of the Moon Goddess has strengthened our resolve to walk our given path.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Really? Well, that's good to hear.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Hah... I suppose we really do have nothing to talk about.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: I'm afraid that... is because there's far too much history between the Frostmoon Scions and the Fatui.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Speaking purely for myself, I'm grateful for your efforts in protecting Nod-Krai and welcoming back the Moon Goddess, Miss Sandrone. But as for your associates...

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: I understand. For various reasons, we failed to establish friendly relations — or even mutually beneficial ones.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: But the Fatui no longer seek to take anything from the Frostmoon Scions, and I have reminded my subordinates not to make things difficult.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: From where I stand, seeing as we're neighbors, even if we can't coexist in perfect harmony, it would be nice if we could at least treat each other with mutual respect.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: I'm afraid that will take time...

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Undoubtedly. But we can start by taking one small step at a time. Would you like to try this herbal tea I prepared?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Oh? Herbal tea...?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Hmm... Such rich flavor. Did you brew this the Frostmoon Scions' way? Most outsiders I've met don't like our tea. How did you...

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: By learning. And showing respect.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Hah... Not a bad first step.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: I hope it suits your tastes.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: I like it a lot.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Amicable exchanges over hot pots of tea have always been a great way to strike up friendly relations.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: I have a feeling this time will be no exception.

talks.objective: Go to the Frostmoon Enclave to start the tea party

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: A truly delicious herbal tea, Miss Sandrone. It's like I can taste your sincerity.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: (Let's sit like this for a little while longer.)

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Alright. Next time, I'll have to invite you for tea.
